select 
                                      object_id,
                                      s_info_windcode,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      market,
                                      strength,
                                      weakkness,
                                      bottoming_b,
                                      bottoming_d,
                                      dmi_pdi,
                                      dmi_mdi,
                                      dmi_adx,
                                      dmi_adxr,
                                      expma,
                                      ma_5d,
                                      ma_10d,
                                      ma_20d,
                                      ma_30d,
                                      ma_60d,
                                      ma_120d,
                                      ma_250d,
                                      macd_diff,
                                      macd_dea,
                                      macd_macd,
                                      bbi,
                                      ddi,
                                      ddi_addi,
                                      ddi_ad,
                                      dma_ddd,
                                      dma_ama,
                                      mtm,
                                      mtm_mtmma,
                                      priceosc,
                                      trix,
                                      trma,
                                      sar,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_ashareintensitytrend.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.ashareintensitytrend WHERE trade_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
